note: P4375 (Pro 30:22) — a slave when he becomes king, and a fool when he is filled with food.

dims.v: insufferable folly — the fool grown full and unbearable

the fool when he is filled with food — folly given plenty and ease, so that it swells into something the earth can hardly bear, a fool with abundance being intolerable where a fool in want was merely pitiable
the folly that plenty makes insufferable

nabal (fool) — 'a FOOL when he is filled with food'; one of the four things the earth cannot bear. A fool made comfortable and full grows insufferable — plenty gives folly power and removes its restraint (cf 1:32; 30:9).
